notes: v7.6.1: swept the remaining 25 ANSI-decoding reads. On PS 5.1 Get-Content -Raw without -Encoding decodes with the ANSI codepage (Windows-1252), so any UTF-8 file read that way and written back becomes mojibake. v7.6.0 fixed the preamble read; this covers 25 more call sites across 10 files, all replaced with [IO.File]::ReadAllText (every path is Join-Path-built from an absolute root). The dangerous one was Add-Reasoning-MCPs.ps1 Add-ToJsonMcp: it read ~/.claude.json with the ANSI path, round-tripped through ConvertFrom-Json/ConvertTo-Json and wrote it back - measured on a real copy, all 26 em dashes destroyed (fixed path preserves all 26). It had not fired only because the script skips writing when all three servers are already present. Read-then-write sites in V7-Common.ps1, Setup-HouseCarl.ps1 and Install-Completeness-Gate.ps1 fixed too; read-only sites swept so a future write cannot inherit the bug. Writes untouched (Set-Content -Encoding utf8 adds a BOM; v6 shipped one that broke skill discovery). New gate section 7b fails the build if a bare Get-Content -Raw returns, verified by reintroducing the bug at Build-Toolbelt.ps1:38 and confirming PACK GATE: FAIL; the one deliberate use is marked '# ansi-intentional'. Line endings verified per file against HEAD; sweep is exactly 25 insertions / 25 deletions. PACK GATE: PASS (9 sections).
